name: Combobox
description: A text input that filters a listbox: pick one match, or several shown as removable chips, and optionally create a value that isn't listed. It shares the field anatomy with Input and Select. Filtering is local by default; remote hands the search to the app or server. Replaces Choices, ChoicesOffline and Tags (multiple + allowCreate).

livewire.name: combobox
capabilities: wire:model binds value (a string, or an array with multiple) through $wire.entangle()
search-model entangles the search text with a Livewire property, debounced, for remote search

props.name: size
props.description: Control height. Emitted as data-size.

props.name: options
props.description: The options: strings, or { value, label, description, icon, color, disabled } objects. description is a second line; color tints the option's chip with multiple.

props.name: label
props.description: The visible label, linked to the input.

props.name: hint
props.description: Help text under the control, linked with aria-describedby.

props.name: error
props.description: Validation message. Marks the field invalid and is linked with aria-describedby.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the field invalid without a message. Emitted as data-invalid.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the input, the buttons and the chips.

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the field required and shows the required mark.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Shown in the empty input. Translated by default.

props.name: name
props.description: Submits the value with a native form: a hidden input carrying the value, or one per value with multiple (use a name such as tags[] if the server expects an array). None while the value is empty. The text input itself has no name.

props.name: value
props.description: The selected value: a string, or an array of strings with multiple. Livewire binds it with wire:model, Vue with v-model.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial value of an uncontrolled combobox.

props.name: multiple
props.description: Selects several values, shown as removable chips before the input. Backspace in the empty input removes the last one. Emitted as data-multiple.

props.name: max
props.description: With multiple, the most values that can be chosen. Once reached, the other options are disabled.

props.name: allowCreate
props.description: Offers “Create …” for typed text that matches no option, ignoring case and accents. Choosing it adds the text as a value and fires create. With multiple, this is the tags input.

props.name: remote
props.description: The app filters the options: typing fires search-change and the combobox shows the options it's given, unfiltered. Without it, options are filtered by label here.

props.name: search
props.description: The text in the input when it renders: it filters the options (unless remote) and marks the matches.

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows a spinner in the control and the loading text in the listbox, while remote results load. Emitted as data-loading.

props.name: clearable
props.description: Adds a button that clears the value, shown while there is one.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the listbox is open. Vue binds it with v-model:open.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: The initial state of an uncontrolled listbox.

props.name: portal
props.description: Renders the listbox at the end of the body, above everything (x-teleport, a React portal, Vue Teleport). Off renders it in place.

props.name: leadingIcon
props.description: Icon name before the input, resolved through the icon registry. A slot or node overrides it.

props.name: emptyLabel
props.description: Shown in the listbox when nothing matches; {search} is the typed text. The empty slot overrides it. Livewire translates it with :search.

props.name: loadingLabel
props.description: Shown in the listbox while loading.

props.name: createLabel
props.description: The create option's text; {value} is the typed text. Livewire translates it with :value.

props.name: removeLabel
props.description: Each chip's remove button's accessible name; {label} is the chip's label. Livewire translates it with :label.

props.name: removedLabel
props.description: Announced when a chip is removed. Livewire translates it with :label.

props.name: clearLabel
props.description: The clear button's accessible name.

props.name: triggerLabel
props.description: The chevron button's accessible name.

props.name: searchModel
props.description: The Livewire property the search text is entangled with, after debounce. The component reads it to filter the options it renders.

props.name: debounce
props.description: Milliseconds to wait after typing before setting search-model.

props.name: errorField
props.description: The validation key to read from $errors. Defaults to the wire:model name.

props.name: classes
props.description: Extra classes per part, such as { label: '…', content: '…', chip: '…' }.

parts.name: root
parts.description: The field: label, control, hint, error and the listbox. Zag's root part.

parts.name: label
parts.description: The visible label, for the input.

parts.name: required
parts.description: The required mark inside the label. Hidden from screen readers; the input is required.

parts.name: box
parts.description: The bordered box around the icon, the chips, the input and the buttons, as in Input and Select (D-018). Zag's control part, renamed.

parts.name: icon
parts.description: Leading icon in the control, and an option's icon.

parts.name: chip
parts.description: With multiple, one chosen value. Tinted by the option's color.

parts.name: chipRemove
parts.description: A chip's remove button, labelled by removeLabel.

parts.name: control
parts.description: The text input: role combobox. Attributes go to the root, not here, since its text isn't the value. Zag's input part, renamed (D-018).

parts.name: spinner
parts.description: Shown in the control while loading.

parts.name: clearTrigger
parts.description: Clears the value. Rendered with clearable, hidden while there's no value.

parts.name: trigger
parts.description: The chevron that opens and closes the listbox. Not in the tab order; the input has the keyboard.

parts.name: hint
parts.description: Help text.

parts.name: error
parts.description: Validation message, with an icon.

parts.name: positioner
parts.description: Places the listbox under the control, as wide as it.

parts.name: content
parts.description: The listbox: role listbox. The spec's listbox.

parts.name: item
parts.description: An option: role option. The spec's option. The create option is an item with data-create.

parts.name: itemText
parts.description: An option's label.

parts.name: mark
parts.description: The part of a label that matches the typed text: bold and underlined, never color alone.

parts.name: itemDescription
parts.description: An option's second line. The spec's description.

parts.name: itemIndicator
parts.description: With multiple, the check on a chosen option.

parts.name: empty
parts.description: Shown in the listbox when nothing matches, or while loading.

parts.name: status
parts.description: Visually hidden live region that announces a removed chip.

slots.name: empty
slots.description: Overrides the empty text, such as a link to add a record.

slots.name: item
slots.description: Renders each option's content, given the option. Scoped: @scope('item', $option) in Blade, #item="{ option }" in Vue, renderItem in React.

events.name: value-change
events.description: A choice changed the value: a string or null, or an array with multiple.

events.name: search-change
events.description: The person typed. The payload is the text; with remote, that's the query to filter by.

events.name: open-change
events.description: The listbox opened or closed itself. Setting open doesn't fire it.

events.name: create
events.description: The create option was chosen. The payload is the new value, already in the value; add it to the options to keep it.

keyboard.action: Filters the options (or sends the search, with remote) and highlights the first match.
Opens the listbox and moves through the options, skipping disabled ones.
Moves to the first or last option while open.
Chooses the highlighted option; with multiple, toggles it and keeps the listbox open.
Closes the listbox; the value stays.
With multiple, in the empty input, removes the last chip and announces it.

requirements: The input is role combobox with aria-expanded, aria-controls, aria-autocomplete=list and aria-activedescendant on the highlighted option.
The listbox is role listbox, labelled by the label; with multiple it sets aria-multiselectable, and chosen options set aria-selected.
Matches are shown with weight and an underline, not color.
The result count is announced as the list changes (translated); the empty state explains what to do next.
Each chip's remove button is labelled “Remove {label}”; removing a chip with Backspace is announced through the status region.
The label is always visible and linked with for/id; hint and error are linked with aria-describedby; invalid sets aria-invalid.
Visible focus ring on the box while the input (control) has :focus-visible; the highlighted option shows the hover tint and, from the keyboard, the ring.
The listbox opens under the control at its start edge and mirrors in RTL; it flips when there's no room.
Every part keeps a stable, server-rendered id in Livewire and options carry wire:key (D-015).
With name, the value is submitted through hidden inputs; the visible input's text (a label) is never submitted.

parts.error: Choose a property from the list.
